items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of playing for her a lot

ctx.x: We called him Spratman -- James Spratman. She did a lot of things down in -- even at Shelley Mann and the Manhole The Cellar -- Shelley Mann and the Manhole -- Helen Humes. And I had the pleasure of playing for her a lot, and, of course, Sprat that was her husband -- he introduced me to her (unintelligible).

items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher Henderson I knew. And then his brother Horace Henderson, because mostly boys used to play with him, Horace.

ctx.x: Fletcher Henderson I knew. And then his brother Horace Henderson, because mostly boys used to play with him, Horace. But this . . .
